Package gov.cdc.izgateway.logging.info

Class HostInfo

java.lang.Object
gov.cdc.izgateway.logging.info.HostInfo
Direct Known Subclasses:
EndPointInfo
public class HostInfo extends Object
The HostInfo record records the information that can be known about a host without connecting to it or being connected to it. That's basically the DNS name (host) and IP Address.
